paper text.text: Suppose $B_1$ consists of one bridge, with attachments $\{a,b,d\}$ by symmetry. Put $H_4=B_1+ab+ad$. If $H_4$ is nonplanar, deleting $E$ and contracting the interior of $B$ to one vertex still leaves $H_4$ in both tests. By minimality, $E=\varnothing$ and $B$ has one interior vertex. Likewise, no proper allowed reduction of $B_1$ keeps $H_4$ nonplanar. Corollary~\ref{common:reduced-forms}, with added edges $ab,ad$, gives the $349$ forms in~\supp{E22}. Each resulting graph has a $K_5$ minor, a cut of at most two vertices, or a proper nontoroidal minor.

vertex names: Psi_3: twins p, q with neighbourhood {a,b,c} and r, z with neighbourhood {a,d,e}, as in Section 6. Further vertices with neighbourhood {a,b,c} are p3, p4, and with {a,d,e} r3, r4. Interior vertices of bridges are u0, u1, ...
